comments.text:
Ztk (MKT465)
The first thing is learning. Madam onek joss poray. Every topics onek joss poray. Brand management niye madam er onek idea ache. So, class lecture gula onek effective hoy. Madam class lecture er pashapashi onek case study poray. So, real market scenario somporkeo ekta valo idea hoy.
The second thing is, exam pattern. Quiz MCQ. 3/4 to best 2 count korbe. Quiz er jonno, slide and class lecture valo kore note kore pore gelei enough.
Mid and Final e written and mcq thake. Mcq quiz er motoi. Madam mcq te onek brand (maximum e unknown) example diye questions kore. So, topics somporke idea thaka must. Written er jonno, madam case study dibe. Then oi basis e question korbe. Madam per question er por ekta box rakhe. Habi jabi jinish na likhe exact point e likhben. Mid and final e pencil, eraser, color pencil niye jaben. Because, madam exam e Brand logo, Brand Character, Ad eshob aakte bolbe.
Now, the third thing is, Individual Presentation, Group report and Group presentation. Individual Presentation er topic khub e simple. If you are a product, tahole ki hoten? Seta ke kivabe apni brand banaben? Group report e ekta GI products assign koredibe madam prottekta group ke. Oitar upor group report and presentation dite hobe. Presentation slide e spelling mistake kora jabe na. Madam donot like this.
Madam ektu strict and 19 to 20 hle bokaboki kore. So, madam er rules mene cholte hobe.
Grading fair. Curve koren na generally.
